This is an unusual presentation - a referral with no reported symptoms at all. This suggests an objective finding discovered elsewhere (abnormal lab, incidental imaging finding, vital sign abnormality, or screening referral). Let me investigate systematically.

1. Complete physical examination including vital signs, general appearance, cardiovascular auscultation, pulmonary auscultation, abdominal palpation, lymph node survey, thyroid palpation, and skin inspection

2. Complete blood count with differential

3. Comprehensive metabolic panel

4. Urinalysis

5. Thyroid stimulating hormone level

6. Electrocardiogram

7. Chest X-ray

8. Fasting lipid panel

9. Hemoglobin A1c
